displayName: OCI-AUTH-045: Authentication — Conditional Access Policy Bypass
description:
Detects attempts to bypass conditional access policies through legacy protocols or exemption abuse

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_auth_045", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%authentication%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%conditional%') AND "value" > 0
